summary: Interpreting the step-down receipt b973d91f2e78491f8305db97ba30499c, where all three comparisons are complete and satisfied. A follower proposed the removal of the sitting leader, after which the removed leader was a StateFollower with voter false and no leader known; with the clock advanced, node 2 reported StateLeader while the other two reported StateFollower, so a new leader was elected among the remaining voters; and a payload proposed on that leader returned with no error and was committed, observed on nodes 2 and 3 but not on the removed node. The question is marked explained, a knowledge entry carries the transition with its parsed indices, and the interpretation states what it does and does not establish: the documented option held in this scenario, which complements the other scenarios where the option is off and a removed leader keeps leading, and the observation also draws the boundary of the parent finding, since a removed node stays a follower that applies nothing new rather than a member whose proposals are held. Limitations are recorded: elections needed the clock to be advanced, only the follower-removes-leader direction was executed, and reliable delivery means nothing is claimed about a removed leader that cannot hear the new configuration. No defect judgment is made for this control.
